_comment: Sokoban scene config — top-down 2D grid. tick_seconds=0 means 'tick on input only' (turn-based). Cell size = 32px. position_scale=1.0 because we author in pixels.

camera._: Center on floor bbox + auto-zoom-to-fit so the whole level is visible regardless of size. fit_padding=64 leaves a margin of 2 cells. lerp=1.0 + zoom_lerp=1.0 = instant snap (turn-based — no smoothing needed). Updates per-frame so transitions reframe automatically.

_comment_tick: tick_seconds=0.1 (10Hz) — sokoban is turn-based, no continuous motion. All inputs are press-edge (one cell move per keypress). Slow tick saves cycles with zero gameplay cost. Per CLAUDE.md § Tick rate is the engine's heartbeat, this is a deliberate per-game override of the 60Hz default.
